variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
